description.value: Concept properties for the HL7 JIRA Spec Work Group entries.

definition.value: A boolean property that indicates the whether an entity is a HL7 JIRA Spec work group.
A string property that represents the primary key for the HL7 JIRA Spec Work Group entry.
A string property from which the work group's web page on the HL7 International website can be derived.
A boolean property that indicates whether a work group has been deprecated.
A string property that represents the work group's listserv email address.
